title: Open-Less/openless
claim: Open-Less/openless — Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Win
why_good: OpenLess is an open-source, cross-platform voice input app for macOS and Windows. Hold a hotkey, speak, and it transcribes, AI-polishes in your chosen style, and streams the text to your cursor in any app—with a unique AI-prompt mode that turns free speech into a structured prompt for ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor.
value: Freelance writers and Chinese content creators pay for a polished, easy-to-install voice input that saves hours per week and produces ready-to-publish text in their platform's style.
risk: Wispr Flow's superior marketing and polish may already have captured the mainstream, leaving OpenLess as a niche for developers only.
does: OpenLess is an open-source, cross-platform voice input app for macOS and Windows. Hold a hotkey, speak, and it transcribes, AI-polishes in your chosen style, and streams the text to your cursor in any app—with a unique AI-prompt mode that turns free speech into a structured prompt for ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor.
why_use: Unlike dictation tools that emit word-for-word transcripts, OpenLess polishes in your style, remembers proper nouns via hotwords, and inserts text at the cursor with clipboard fallback. It's free and open-source, so you avoid subscription fees and keep your data local.
gap: Voice input is still geeky—requires setup and lacks polished consumer UX; the gap is a simple, reliable, cross-platform voice-to-text that works everywhere without configuration.
counter: Wispr Flow and Superwhisper already own this space with polished apps and aggressive marketing; a platform like Apple or Microsoft could kill it with a native feature in an OS update. It may be a feature, not a company.
differentiator: Package it for ordinary people: a one-click installer, pre-built style packs for Chinese platforms (小红书, 微信公众号), and a local-private version that runs entirely on-device for privacy-conscious users.
hook: Freelancers and knowledge workers who type 10,000 words a day are in pain: dictation tools dump raw transcripts, and they waste minutes every hour cleaning up filler words, fixing proper nouns, and re-pasting text into C

zh.hook: 每天打一万字的自由职业者和知识工作者很痛苦：听写工具输出原始转录，他们每小时都要浪费几分钟清理语气词、修正专有名词、再粘贴到ChatGPT里润色。
zh.does: OpenLess是一款开源的跨平台语音输入应用，支持macOS和Windows。按住热键说话，它会转录、按你选择的风格进行AI润色，并将文本流式插入到任何应用的光标处——其独特的AI提示模式能将自由语音转化为可直接粘贴到ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor的结构化提示。
zh.why_use: 与输出逐字转录的听写工具不同，OpenLess能按你的风格润色，通过热词记住专有名词，并在光标处插入文本，还支持剪贴板回退。它免费开源，避免订阅费用，且数据可本地化。
zh.gap: 只有极客能用：它只是一个GitHub仓库，需要自行配置，没有面向普通用户的成熟产品或一键安装包，而且中国市场空白——没有针对小红书/微信用户的本地化风格包或文档。
zh.counter: Wispr Flow和Superwhisper已经用成熟的应用和激进的营销占据了这一领域；苹果或微软等平台可能通过系统更新中的原生功能将其扼杀。它可能只是一个功能，而不是一家公司。
zh.differentiator: 为普通人打包：一键安装、为中文平台（小红书、微信公众号）预置风格包，以及完全本地运行的隐私版本，面向注重隐私的用户。
zh.value: 自由撰稿人和中文内容创作者为安装简便、能节省每周数小时并产出符合平台风格的即用文本的语音输入付费。
zh.risk: Wispr Flow的优越营销和精致度可能已占据主流，使OpenLess沦为开发者的小众工具。
zh.why_good: OpenLess是一款开源的跨平台语音输入应用，支持macOS和Windows。按住热键说话，它会转录、按你选择的风格进行AI润色，并将文本流式插入到任何应用的光标处——其独特的AI提示模式能将自由语音转化为可直接粘贴到ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor的结构化提示。
zh.claim: Open-Less/openless — 按住按键，说话，松开 — AI润色后的文字即刻出现在任意应用的鼠标光标处。适用于macOS和Windows的开源语音输入工具

consumer_angle: Ordinary people want to dictate text into any app without fiddling with settings; this could be a Siri-like utility for desktop.
pick_reason: Strong activity and forks show real use, but the product is still developer-oriented and needs a consumer-friendly wrapper.
